abilityWords.definition: An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever the creature and at least two other creatures attack.
An ability word that highlights activated abilities you can use by discarding the creature card to give an attacking creature a bonus.
An ability word that highlights activated abilities you can use by discarding the card from your hand for an effect.
An ability word that highlights abilities that count mana symbols in costs of cards.
An ability word that highlights activated abilities requiring you to tap the creature and another untapped Ally you control.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever an enchantment enters the battlefield under your control.
An ability word that highlights abilities that scale based on the number of colors of mana spent to cast the spell.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An ability word that highlights abilities that scale based on the number of basic land types among lands you control.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you have 5 or less life.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you control a creature with power 4 or greater.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if creatures you control have total power 8 or greater.
An ability word that highlights activated abilities requiring you to discard another card with the same name.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you have no cards in hand.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature.
An ability word that highlights abilities that exile a card and then reference that exiled card for other effects.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever this creature becomes untapped.
An ability word that highlights abilities where each player may pay mana, and the effect scales based on total mana paid.

An ability word that highlights abilities triggering at the beginning of your upkeep where you may look at the top card of your library and get a bonus if it shares a creature type with this creature.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you control your commander.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you control three or more artifacts.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if a creature died this turn.
An ability word that highlights abilities where each player reveals the top card of their library, draws it, and effects scale based on cards revealed.
An ability word that highlights abilities that affect a target and all other permanents that share a color with it.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you attacked with a creature this turn.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever this creature or another Ally enters the battlefield under your control.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard.
An ability word that highlights spells with an additional cost you may pay multiple times to add more targets.
An ability word that highlights abilities where you may return any number of a basic land type you control to your hand, and the effect scales based on lands returned.
An ability word that highlights abilities where each opponent may take a bonus, and you get that bonus for each opponent who does.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
An ability word that highlights abilities where players vote and the outcome is determined by the vote results.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if at least three mana of a single color was spent to cast the spell.
An ability word that highlights abilities that provide an additional effect if the spell was cast during your main phase.
An ability word that highlights abilities where each player votes for one of two options, and effects happen based on how many votes each option received.
An ability word that highlights abilities that function both from the command zone and the battlefield.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever this creature is dealt damage.
An ability word that highlights abilities that grant a reward when certain heroic conditions are met.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever another creature that shares a creature type enters the battlefield under your control.
An ability word that highlights abilities involving lands and Vehicles or relating to lands becoming creatures.
An ability word that highlights abilities that provide benefits based on cards or effects from previous games in a multi-game match.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you have less life than an opponent.
An ability word that highlights abilities that scale based on the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
An ability word that highlights abilities involving colorless mana, the exile zone, or processing exiled cards.
An ability word that highlights abilities that check how many permanent cards are in your graveyard; often with thresholds at 4 or 8.
An ability word that highlights abilities that scale continuously based on the number of permanent cards in your graveyard.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell.
An ability word that highlights abilities that provide bonuses when creatures work together or share characteristics.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever this creature attacks if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if you control three or more creatures with different powers.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
An ability word that highlights abilities where players secretly vote, then reveal votes simultaneously.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if two or more nonland permanents entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand.
An ability word that highlights abilities where planeswalkers you control can vote in addition to players.
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering at the beginning of your second main phase if this creature is tapped.
An ability word that highlights abilities that are active or improved if this is the second time you've performed an action this turn (often attacking).
An ability word that highlights abilities triggering whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability you control for the first time each turn.
An ability word that highlights abilities involving Vehicles becoming crewed or beginning to attack.
An ability word that highlights abilities that provide healing or restoration effects.
An ability word that highlights abilities that activate when mana of specific colors is used or when color requirements are met.

keywordAbilities.definition: If a creature with absorb N would be dealt damage, prevent N of that damage.
Affinity for [type] means this spell costs {1} less to cast for each [type] you control.
Afflict N means whenever this creature becomes blocked, defending player loses N life.
Afterlife N means when this creature dies, create N 1/1 white and black Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Aftermath appears on the bottom half of split cards. You may cast that half only from your graveyard, then exile the card.
Amplify N means as this creature enters the battlefield, reveal any number of cards from your hand that share a creature type with it. It enters with N +1/+1 counters for each card revealed.
Annihilator N means whenever this creature attacks, defending player sacrifices N permanents.
If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game. (Cards with ascend have bonuses if you have the city's blessing.)
Another player can pay up to the generic mana cost of this spell as you cast it.
Augment {cost} means you may pay {cost} and combine this card with a host creature to create a new merged creature. (Un-set mechanic)
Aura Swap {cost} means you may pay {cost} to exchange this Aura with an Aura card in your hand.
Awaken N—{cost} means you may cast this spell for its awaken cost. If you do, put N +1/+1 counters on target land you control, and it becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land.
Backup N means when this creature enters the battlefield, put N +1/+1 counters on target creature. If that's another creature, it gains the abilities below this until end of turn.

Any creatures with banding, and up to one without, can attack in a band. Bands are blocked as a group. If any creatures with banding a player controls are blocking or being blocked, that player divides combat damage.
You may sacrifice an artifact, enchantment, or token as an additional cost to cast this spell. If you do, it's bargained and may have additional effects.
Basic landcycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Whenever this creature attacks, each other attacking creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
Bestow {cost} means you may cast this card for its bestow cost as an Aura enchanting a creature. If the creature leaves, this becomes a creature again.
Blitz {cost} means you may cast this spell for its blitz cost. If you do, it gains haste and 'When this creature dies, draw a card.' Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.
Bloodthirst N means if an opponent was dealt damage this turn, this creature enters the battlefield with N +1/+1 counters.
Boast abilities can be activated only if this creature attacked this turn and only once each turn.
Bushido N means whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N until end of turn.
Buyback {cost} means you may pay an additional {cost} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.

When you cast this spell, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card that costs less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. Put the exiled cards on the bottom in a random order.
Casualty N means as an additional cost, you may sacrifice a creature with power N or greater. If you do, copy this spell.
Champion a [type] means when this enters, sacrifice it unless you exile another [type] you control. When this leaves, return the exiled card to the battlefield.
This card is every creature type at all times.
You can have a Background as a second commander. (Background is an enchantment type.)
You may exile this spell card encoded on a creature you control. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast a copy of the encoded card without paying its mana cost.
Cleave {cost} means you may cast this spell for its cleave cost. If you do, remove the words in square brackets from the rules text.
Commander ninjutsu {cost} works like ninjutsu, but you can also activate it from the command zone.
You may reveal this card from outside the game if your starting deck meets the stated condition. Once during the game, you may pay {3} to put it into your hand from outside the game.
Compleated means you may pay 2 life instead of paying one of the colored mana in this cost. If you do, the planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters.
Conspire means as an additional cost, you may tap two untapped creatures you control that share a color with this spell. If you do, copy this spell.
Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.

Craft with [materials] {cost} means you may pay {cost} and exile this card along with the specified materials from among permanents you control and/or cards in your graveyard. If you do, return this card transformed.
Crew N means tap any number of creatures you control with total power N or greater: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, put an age counter on this permanent, then sacrifice it unless you pay its upkeep cost for each age counter on it.
Cycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to draw a card.
Dash {cost} means you may cast this spell for its dash cost. If you do, it gains haste, and it's returned to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.
If a player casts no spells during their own turn, it becomes night next turn. This permanent transforms when it becomes night.
Any amount of damage this deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.
A creature with decayed can't block. When it attacks, sacrifice it at end of combat.
This creature can't attack.
Each card you exile from your graveyard while casting this spell pays for {1}.
When you cast this spell, you may copy it. If you do, choose an opponent. That player copies it as well.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Desert.
Whenever this creature attacks the player with the most life or tied for most life, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
This card has no color.
Devour N means as this creature enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures. It enters with N +1/+1 counters for each creature sacrificed.
You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature with ward {2} for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its disguise cost.
Disturb {cost} means you may cast this card transformed from your graveyard for its disturb cost.
You can have two commanders if the other is the Doctor. (Doctor Who set mechanic.)
Start the game with this conspiracy face down in the command zone and secretly choose two card names. (Conspiracy set mechanic.)
This creature deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.
When this creature attacks, if it's not a token, conjure a duplicate of this card into your hand. Exile this card at end of combat. (MTG Arena mechanic.)
Dredge N means if you would draw a card, you may instead mill N cards and return this card from your graveyard to your hand.
Echo {cost} means at the beginning of your upkeep, if this came under your control since the beginning of your last upkeep, sacrifice it unless you pay its echo cost.

Embalm {cost} means you may pay {cost} and exile this card from your graveyard to create a token that's a copy of it, except it's white, has no mana cost, and is a Zombie in addition to its other types.
Emerge {cost} means you may cast this spell by sacrificing a creature and paying the emerge cost minus that creature's mana value.
Enchant [type] means this Aura can only be attached to a [type]. It enters attached to that permanent.
Encore {cost} means pay {cost} and exile this card from your graveyard: For each opponent, create a token copy that attacks that opponent this turn if able. Sacrifice the tokens at end of turn.
As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.
Entwine {cost} means you may pay an additional {cost} as you cast this spell. If you do, choose all modes instead of just one.
When you cast this spell, copy it at the beginning of each of your upkeeps for the rest of the game. You can't cast spells for the rest of the game.
Equip {cost} means {cost}: Attach this Equipment to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.
Escalate {cost} means you may pay {cost} for each mode chosen beyond the first.
Escape {cost} means you may cast this card from your graveyard by paying its escape cost and exiling a specified number of other cards from your graveyard.
Eternalize {cost} means pay {cost} and exile this card from your graveyard to create a token copy that's 4/4, black, has no mana cost, and is a Zombie in addition to its other types.
Evoke {cost} means you may cast this spell for its evoke cost. If you do, sacrifice it when it enters the battlefield.
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate only once during each of your turns and only if this creature attacked during the current turn.
When this creature enters the battlefield, you may sacrifice a creature. (Cards with exploit have abilities that trigger when they exploit a creature.)
Whenever you cast a spell, you may pay {W/B}. If you do, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain that much life.
Fabricate N means when this creature enters the battlefield, put N +1/+1 counters on it, or create N 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens.
Fading N means this permanent enters with N fade counters. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a fade counter. If you can't, sacrifice it.
This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or black creatures.
This creature's abilities or effects involve fire-based magic. (Avatar: The Last Airbender set mechanic.)
This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.
Whenever a creature without flanking blocks this creature, the blocking creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.
Flashback {cost} means you may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost, then exile it.
This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.
When this Equipment enters the battlefield, create a 2/2 red Rebel creature token, then attach this to it.
Forecast {cost}: Activate only during your upkeep and only once each turn, reveal this card from your hand and pay {cost} for an effect.
During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card face down from your hand. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.
Forestcycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a Forest card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Forest.
Fortify {cost} means {cost}: Attach this Fortification to target land you control. Fortify only as a sorcery.
Freerunning {cost} means you may cast this spell for its freerunning cost if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with an Assassin or commander.
Frenzy N means whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked, it gets +N/+0 until end of turn.
You can have two commanders if both have friends forever.
You may cast one or both halves of this split card from your hand.
Gift [something] means as an additional cost, you may give the specified gift to an opponent. If you do, you get an additional effect.
Graft N means this permanent enters with N +1/+1 counters. Whenever another creature enters, you may move a +1/+1 counter from this permanent onto it.
When you cast this spell, copy it for each permanent that was put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
Harmonize abilities function when certain harmonic conditions are met. (A more recent set mechanic.)
This creature can attack and tap as soon as it comes under your control.
When this is put into a graveyard from the battlefield or cast from a graveyard, exile it haunting target creature. When that creature dies, the haunt ability triggers again.
This permanent can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.
Hexproof from [quality] means this permanent can't be the target of spells or abilities with that quality that your opponents control.
Start the game with this conspiracy face down in the command zone and secretly choose a card name. (Conspiracy set mechanic.)
Hideaway N means when this permanent enters, look at the top N cards of your library. Exile one face down and put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with horsemanship.

Impending N means you may cast this spell for its impending cost. If you cast it this way, it enters with N time counters and isn't a creature until you remove the last time counter. Remove one at the beginning of your end step.
Your artifacts can help cast this spell. Each artifact you tap while casting this pays for {1}.
Effects that say 'destroy' don't destroy this permanent. Lethal damage doesn't destroy this creature.
This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles the top card of their library.
Intensity represents a scaling power level that can increase as certain conditions are met.
This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or creatures that share a color with it.
Islandcycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for an Island card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an Island.
Job select lets you choose a job for this creature as it enters, granting different abilities based on your choice. (Final Fantasy set mechanic.)
You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs, then exile it.
Kicker {cost} means you may pay an additional {cost} as you cast this spell. If you do, it's kicked and may have additional effects.
Landcycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
Landwalk is a generic term for abilities that make a creature unblockable if the defending player controls a certain type of land.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a legendary land.
Level up {cost} means {cost}: Put a level counter on this. Activate only as a sorcery. Level counters change the creature's stats and abilities.
Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.
As long as it's your turn, this Vehicle is also a creature.
When this Equipment enters the battlefield, create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token, then attach this to it.
Madness {cost} means if you discard this card, you may cast it for its madness cost instead of putting it into your graveyard.
Max speed means this Vehicle has enhanced capabilities when crewed by creatures with enough total power.
Mayhem abilities trigger during chaotic combat situations or when multiple creatures are attacking. (Marvel set mechanic.)
You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its megamorph cost and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat.
This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.
Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature with lesser power.
Miracle {cost} means if this is the first card you drew this turn, you may reveal it and cast it for its miracle cost.
Mobilize abilities involve rallying or coordinating multiple creatures for combat or effects.
Modular N means this creature enters with N +1/+1 counters. When it dies, you may put its +1/+1 counters on target artifact creature.
You may cast this card converted for its More Than Meets the Eye cost. (Transformers set mechanic.)
You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.
Mountaincycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a Mountain card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Mountain.
Multikicker {cost} means you may pay an additional {cost} any number of times as you cast this spell. Effects scale based on how many times you kicked.
Mutate {cost} means you may pay {cost} to cast this spell. If you do, put it over or under a non-Human creature you own. The creature has all abilities of all cards merged with it.
Whenever this creature attacks, for each opponent other than defending player, create a token copy attacking that opponent. Exile the tokens at end of combat.
If a player casts at least two spells during their own turn, it becomes day next turn. This permanent transforms when it becomes day.
Ninjutsu {cost} means you may pay {cost} and return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a nonbasic land.
Offering [type] means you may cast this card any time you could cast an instant by sacrificing a [type] and paying the difference in mana costs.
Offspring {cost} means you may pay an additional {cost} as you cast this spell. If you do, when this creature enters, create a 1/1 token copy of it.
Outlast {cost} means {cost}, tap: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
Overload {cost} means you may cast this spell for its overload cost. If you do, change all instances of 'target' in its text to 'each.'
You can have two commanders if both have partner.
Partner with [name] means when this creature enters, you may search your library for [name], reveal it, and put it into your hand. You can have two commanders if both have partner with each other.
When this creature dies, if it had no -1/-1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
This phases out at the beginning of your untap step before you untap. It phases in before your next untap step. While phased out, it's treated as though it doesn't exist.
Plainscycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Plains.
Plot {cost} means you may pay {cost} and exile this card from your hand face up. On a future turn, you may cast it from exile without paying its mana cost. Plot only as a sorcery.
Poisonous N means whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player gets N poison counters.
Protection from [quality] means this permanent can't be blocked, targeted, dealt damage, enchanted, or equipped by anything with that quality.
Prototype {cost} — P/T means you may cast this spell with a different mana cost, color, power, and toughness. It keeps its abilities.
Whenever this creature attacks, you may have target creature defending player controls untap and block it if able.
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Prowl {cost} means you may cast this for its prowl cost if you dealt combat damage to a player this turn with a creature that shares a creature type with this spell.
Rampage N means whenever this creature becomes blocked, it gets +N/+N for each creature blocking it beyond the first.
Ravenous means this creature enters with X +1/+1 counters. If X is 5 or more, draw a card when it enters.
This creature can block creatures with flying.
Read ahead means when this Saga enters, choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Skip any earlier chapters.
If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it as it resolves. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Reconfigure {cost} means {cost}: Attach to target creature you control, or unattach. Reconfigure only as a sorcery. While attached, this isn't a creature.
Recover {cost} means when a creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay {cost}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Otherwise, exile this card.
Reinforce N—{cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to put N +1/+1 counters on target creature.
Renown N means when this creature deals combat damage to a player, if it isn't renowned, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes renowned.
Replicate {cost} means as an additional cost, you may pay {cost} any number of times. When you cast this spell, copy it for each time you paid its replicate cost.
You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.
This creature enters the battlefield with your choice of a +1/+1 counter or haste.
Ripple N means when you cast this spell, you may reveal the top N cards of your library. You may cast any with the same name without paying their mana costs. Put the rest on the bottom.
Saddle N means tap any number of creatures you control with total power N or greater: This Mount becomes saddled until end of turn.
Scavenge {cost} means {cost}, exile this card from your graveyard: Put a number of +1/+1 counters equal to this card's power on target creature.
This creature can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow.
This permanent can't be the target of spells or abilities.
This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.
Slivercycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a Sliver card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
You may pair this creature with another unpaired creature when either enters the battlefield. They remain paired for as long as you control both.
Soulshift N means when this creature dies, you may return target Spirit card with mana value N or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Specialize {cost} means pay {cost}, discard a card: This creature becomes its specialized version based on the discarded card's color. Activate only as a sorcery.
Spectacle {cost} means you may cast this spell for its spectacle cost if an opponent lost life this turn.
Splice onto [type] {cost} means as you cast a [type] spell, you may reveal this card and pay {cost} to add its effects to that spell.
As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
Spree means you must choose one or more modes and pay their costs in addition to the spell's mana cost.
Squad {cost} means as an additional cost, you may pay {cost} any number of times. When this creature enters, create that many tokens that are copies of it.
Station is a mechanic involving positioning or placement of creatures and effects. (Recent set mechanic.)
When you cast this spell, copy it for each spell cast before it this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.
This permanent enters with a +1/+1 counter (or charge counter if noncreature) for each color of mana spent to cast it.
Surge {cost} means you may cast this spell for its surge cost if you or a teammate has cast another spell this turn.

Suspend N—{cost} means rather than cast this from your hand, you may pay {cost} and exile it with N time counters. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, cast it without paying its mana cost. It has haste.
Swampcycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a Swamp card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Swamp.
Toxic N means whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player gets N poison counters.
Whenever this creature attacks with another creature with greater power, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
Transfigure {cost} means {cost}, sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a creature card with the same mana value, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
Transmute {cost} means {cost}, discard this card: Search your library for a card with the same mana value, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. Activate only as a sorcery.
Tribute N means as this creature enters, an opponent may put N +1/+1 counters on it. If they don't, an ability triggers.
Typecycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a card of the specified type, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
If enchanted creature would be destroyed, instead remove all damage from it and destroy this Aura.
This spell costs {1} less to cast for each opponent.
When this creature dies, if it had no +1/+1 counters on it, return it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter.
Unearth {cost} means pay {cost}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield.
You may have this creature enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vanishing N means this permanent enters with N time counters. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, sacrifice it.
Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.
Ward {cost} means whenever this permanent becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {cost}.
Warp involves manipulating space, time, or the battlefield in unusual ways. (Recent set mechanic.)
Web-slinging allows creatures to move or interact with the battlefield in agile ways. (Marvel Spider-Man set mechanic.)
This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.
Wizardcycling {cost} means you may pay {cost} and discard this card to search your library for a Wizard card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

keywordActions.definition: To abandon a post or position means to leave it, typically removing a creature from a specific game zone or state.
To use an activated ability by paying its cost and putting the ability on the stack.
Adapt N means if this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put N +1/+1 counters on it.
Perform an airbending action, typically involving evasion or manipulation of the stack. (Avatar: The Last Airbender set mechanic.)
Amass [type] N means put N +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. If you don't control one, create a 0/0 [type] Army creature token first.
To assemble a Contraption, put the top card of your Contraption deck face up onto a sprocket. (Un-set mechanic.)
Move an Aura, Equipment, or Fortification onto another permanent. For Equipment and Fortifications, it must be legal to attach to the new permanent.
Behold means to observe a specific card or reveal cards in a particular zone for information or effects.
To blight means to spread corruption or decay, typically putting counters or negative effects on permanents.
Bolster N means put N +1/+1 counters on the creature you control with the least toughness (or tied for least).
To cast a spell, move it from where it is to the stack and pay its costs.
Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts it on top or bottom. A player wins if their card had the highest mana value.
To cloak a card, put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time by paying its mana cost.
Collect evidence N means exile cards with total mana value N or greater from your graveyard as an additional cost.
Create a card in a specified zone that didn't exist before. (MTG Arena digital mechanic.)
Transform all permanents you control that have a back face. (Used in place of transform for simultaneous transformations.)
Negate a spell or ability so it doesn't resolve. It's removed from the stack and put into its owner's graveyard (for spells).
Put a token onto the battlefield with the specified characteristics.
Move a permanent from the battlefield to its owner's graveyard.
Until your next turn, that permanent can't attack or block and its activated abilities can't be activated.
Move a card from your hand to your graveyard.

Discover N means exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value N or less. Cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.
Double a creature's power and toughness, a player's life, or a value means to multiply it by two.
Perform an earthbending action, typically involving lands or toughness-based effects. (Avatar: The Last Airbender set mechanic.)
Endure means to persist through damage or effects, often preventing destruction or returning to the battlefield.
Swap one thing for another (control of permanents, life totals, cards between zones, etc.).
An exerted creature won't untap during your next untap step. (Cards with exert have abilities that trigger or improve when exerted.)
Move a card or permanent to the exile zone.
Reveal the top card of your library. Put it into your hand if it's a land. Otherwise, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then you may put that card into your graveyard.
Fateseal N means look at the top N cards of an opponent's library. Put any number on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.
Each creature deals damage equal to its power to the other. (They don't deal combat damage.)
A Food token is an artifact with '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life.'
Forage means to exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.
Until your next turn, that creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.
Exile the top X cards of target opponent's library face down. You may play those cards for as long as they remain exiled, spending mana as though it were any color.
Incubate N means create an Incubator token with N +1/+1 counters. It's a transforming artifact that can pay {2} to transform into a 0/0 Phyrexian creature with its counters.
Create a Clue token. (It's an artifact with '{2}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.')
You may reveal a Lesson card you own from outside the game and put it into your hand, or discard a card to draw a card.
Put the top card of your library onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time by paying its mana cost if it's a creature card.
Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature.
Exile the two specified cards, then combine them into the oversized melded permanent on their back faces.
Mill N means put the top N cards of your library into your graveyard.
Monstrosity N means if this creature isn't monstrous, put N +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous.
Put the top card of your Attraction deck onto the battlefield. (Un-set mechanic.)
Move to a new plane by putting the current plane on the bottom of the planar deck and revealing the top card. (Planechase format.)
Either cast a spell or put a land onto the battlefield.
Pay the plot cost and exile this card face up. On a later turn, cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Create a copy of a creature token you control.
Choose any number of permanents and/or players with counters on them, then give each one additional counter of each kind already there.
The next time this permanent would be destroyed this turn, instead tap it, remove it from combat, and remove all damage from it.
Show a card to all players.
Create a Role token attached to a creature. (Roles are Aura tokens with specific effects like Cursed, Monster, Royal, Sorcerer, Wicked, Young Hero, etc.)
Roll a six-sided die. Visit each Attraction you control whose lights include the rolled number. (Un-set mechanic.)
Move a permanent you control from the battlefield to your graveyard.
Scry N means look at the top N cards of your library. Put any number on the bottom in any order and the rest on top in any order.
Search your library for a card that meets the criteria and put it into your hand. Shuffle. (MTG Arena digital mechanic—you don't reveal the card.)
Put a scheme card from the command zone face up and follow its instructions. (Archenemy format.)
Randomize the order of cards in a library.
Support N means put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to N target creatures.
Surveil N means look at the top N cards of your library. Put any number into your graveyard and the rest back on top in any order.
A suspected creature has menace and can't block.
Rotate a permanent 90 degrees to show it's been used.
For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter, you may add or remove a time counter.
Turn a double-faced card over to its other face.
A Treasure token is an artifact with '{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.'
Rotate a tapped permanent back to its upright position.
Move to the next room of a dungeon. If you're not in a dungeon, put a dungeon into the command zone and enter its first room.
Each player selects one of the available options in secret or openly, as specified.
Perform a waterbending action, typically involving healing or manipulation of creatures and life. (Avatar: The Last Airbender set mechanic.)
